summary: Iteration 20 - Razorpay billing sync + billing portal + store-build protection. Backend: new suite test_iter20_billing_sync.py 23/23 PASS (webhook signature 400s, event-id dedupe, activated+charged same payment = single +30d, new payment +30d, pending/halted -> billing_issue + failed row then charged clears, cancelled, unknown sub, one-time order payment.captured once (retry with new event id no double extension), payment.failed marks row failed and never downgrades a paid row, verify bad sig 400 / unknown order 404, invoice PDF 200 own paid / 404 unpaid / 404 other org, cron reconcile 200 stats / 403 wrong or missing secret, admin reconcile 403 for owner / 200 super admin, android_store+ios_store: create-order & autodebit/start 403, register+login return tokens, Bearer /auth/me works, JSON refresh returns new access token; web login/register have no tokens; expired trial -> member create 402 but create-order 200; CORS preflight capacitor://localhost allowed with credentials). Frontend (Playwright): /billing unauth -> /login?next=/billing -> lands on /billing; portal-org-name/back-to-app/logout work; trial org sees plan picker (Monthly 999/Quarterly/Yearly) + subscribe-button + renewal-disclosure, Pay opens Razorpay test checkout; active-autodebit org sees autodebit-active-card + cancel-autorenew-button + payment history with invoice download (invoice.pdf 200 application/pdf); receptionist staff sees portal-no-permission and no Pay button. Store mode (/m/login?app=1): X-Client-Platform android_store sent, /m/profile shows in-app-billing-note, no m-sub-price/m-pay-button/price text; trial-banner data-phase=store no CTA; expired account trial-expired-banner data-mode=store, no price, no reactivate-button; /, /billing, /pricing -> /m/home, /app/subscription -> /m/profile. Removing gb-in-app restores m-sub-price + m-pay-button + reactivate-button and landing page. Web regression: forgot-password 200, login, /app members/attendance/payments, /m/attendance load fine.

minor.issue: claim_event() inserts the event id BEFORE processing; if handle_*_event raises (DB blip, etc.) Razorpay's retry with the same X-Razorpay-Event-Id returns {status: duplicate} and the event is lost (only daily reconcile would recover subscriptions; one-time order failures are not recovered). Consider deleting the webhook_events row on exception or marking processed after success.
Ledger row inserted before the org update; if the org update fails, the payment_id is permanently consumed and never applied on retry. Same pattern as above.
Only get_org_user is required - any staff (e.g. receptionist) can start/cancel billing via API although the portal UI restricts to owner/admin. Add an owner/admin role check server-side.
Each pending/halted event (distinct event ids, Razorpay sends several during retries) inserts a new failed payment row - history may show many duplicate failed rows for one renewal.

integration_issues.issue: openInvoice does window.open(blobURL) after an await - Safari/iOS popup blockers may block it since it's no longer in the user-gesture tick. Consider an <a download> fallback.

issues: Plan options (Monthly/Quarterly/Yearly) have no data-testid attributes
